meta_data.base_class: Creates a backup of <a specific type of database>. This is a general backup tool that uses the `db_name` parameter to specify which database to back up. Subclass tools will be hardcoded to a specific database type (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and will remove the `db_name` parameter.

tool_template.name: create_<class>_backup
tool_template.description: This function creates a backup of the <class> before modification.

db_name.description: The established db name of the <class> to create a backup of.

backup_location.description: The file path where the backup should be stored.

timestamp.description: Whether to append a timestamp to the backup file name.

compression.description: Indicates whether the backup of the <class> should be compressed to reduce storage space.

encryption.description: Specifies whether the backup file for the <class> should be encrypted for security purposes.

retention_period.description: The number of days to keep the backup of the <class> before it is automatically deleted.

include_schema.description: Determines if the schema of the <class> should be included in the backup.
